findings.evidence: Center.lean:128-133: `@[simp] theorem reverseEven_eq_self_of_mem_center_of_finrank_eq_four (hQ : Q.Nondegenerate) (hV : finrank K V = 4) {x : even Q} (hx : x ∈ Subalgebra.center K (even Q)) : reverseEven Q x = x`. The author's own dimension-six proofs (lines 140, 149-150) run `simp [hV, ...]` with `hV : finrank K V = 6` in context, where this rule is tried and must fail.
findings.fix: Drop `@[simp]` and leave it a plain theorem applied by name.
findings.issue: `@[simp]` on `reverseEven_eq_self_of_mem_center_of_finrank_eq_four` keys a rule on the bare pattern `reverseEven ?Q ?x`, so it is attempted on every `reverseEven` subterm in every downstream `simp` call, while its three hypotheses (`Q.Nondegenerate`, `finrank K V = 4`, `x ∈ Subalgebra.center K (even Q)`) are not in the LHS and must be discharged by simp — `finrank K V = 4` is not simp-provable in general, so the rule essentially never fires and only costs discharge attempts. Contrast the existing `@[simp] coe_adjoinRootEquivCenterEven_root` (Even/Center.lean:327), whose hypotheses `hl hlen hne hspan hQl` all appear in the LHS and are therefore matched, not discharged.

findings.evidence: Center.lean:111-122 constructs `ω`, proves `hω` via `prod_map_ι_mem_center_even_of_even_length`, and closes with `prod_map_ι_ne_algebraMap_of_even_length hl hle hne hQl a ...`; lines 111-114 are verbatim lines 78-81.
findings.fix: Extract a lemma, e.g. `exists_mem_center_even_forall_ne_algebraMap (hQ : Q.Nondegenerate) (heven : Even (finrank K V)) (hpos : 0 < finrank K V) : ∃ x ∈ Subalgebra.center K (even Q), ∀ a : K, x ≠ algebraMap K (even Q) a`, proved once from `prod_map_ι_mem_center_even_of_even_length` and `prod_map_ι_ne_algebraMap_of_even_length`, and have `forall_reverseEven_eq_self_on_center_iff` consume it instead of rebuilding `l`, `ω` and the invertibility instance.
findings.issue: The forward branch re-derives the whole setup of `reverseEven_eq_self_iff_of_mem_center` (`Invertible (2 : K)`, `hQ.exists_list_pairwise_isOrtho`, `hle`, `hne` — lines 111-114 duplicate 78-81) in order to prove an unstated reusable fact: the centre of `even Q` contains an element that is not a scalar. That fact (the discriminant algebra is strictly bigger than `K`) is independently useful — it is what the announced dimension-four quaternion description needs — and no such lemma exists in the repo (`grep` over `TauCeti/` finds only `prod_map_ι_ne_algebraMap_of_even_length`, stated about the raw volume element, not about the centre).

summary: Proofs are mostly automation-driven and readable, but the dimension-four result is tagged @[simp] with a maximally general LHS and three hypotheses simp cannot discharge, and the forward direction of forall_reverseEven_eq_self_on_center_iff buries a reusable fact (the centre contains a non-scalar element) in a tactic block that also re-derives the orthogonal-list setup.
